decision_variable: Nominal policy theta, not executed controls
cost: Mean of whole-grid cumulative positive clarity deficits over coherent outer winds and observation noise; all costs computed after RPCBF
weight: exp(-(mean_cost - min_mean_cost)/temperature); bounded latent support and invalid forecast receive zero weight
target: Uniform box [-6,6]^d with finite valid subset of positive volume. Historical default bound=0 retained only for archive reproduction.
reverse: Pan et al. score identity and reverse update; finite self-normalized estimates and warm starts are approximations, not exact target sampling
causality: First controls shared; condition only at executed observation boundaries; continue physical/clarity states; same outer physical draw persists; separate inner sample bank
new_failure_fix: All-invalid level retains noisy iterate and reports ESS=0; optimization cost remains infinity. Prior regression and failure log retained.
